build_resize_shortest_edge: build a ResizeShortestEdge transformer to resize observation images by their shortest edge while maintaining aspect ratio
create_center_cropper: create a CenterCropper transformer to center crop RGB, depth, and semantic observation images to a fixed size

create_cubemap_to_equirect: create a CubeMap2Equirect transformer to stitch six cubemap camera sensors into a single equirectangular 360 image
